purpose: Your money at a glance. See how much you have, what's coming, and how you're doing.
see: Your total in your main currency. · Balances by account. · Upcoming payments. · Your active goals and debts.
do: Record an expense or income. · Change the currency with the selector above. · Tap any card to see the detail.

faq.q: Why doesn't my total match the bank?
faq.a: It only adds up what you recorded here. Check that each account's starting balance is up to date.

faq.q: What rate do you use to convert?
faq.a: The real rate of the day. If we couldn't fetch it, we use the latest one available and let you know.
